readme:
MEASURING WHAT MATTERS. Core Principle: "Impact visualization meets organic hope" Mission Statement Reflected in Design:.

**Blend:** Nonprofit Alliance 35% + Solarpunk Biophilic 25% + Organic Modern 20% + Duotone 20%  
**Temperature:** 7/10 (warm) · **Formality:** 7/10 · **Tags:** creative, association  
**Perfect for:** Impact Networks, Nonprofit Alliances, Social Enterprise

## Content fundamentals

- Write for members and staff of the organization: direct, professional but warm.
- Headings name the thing plainly: “Impact Collective”, “Our Impact This Year”, “Stories of Change”, “Education for All”.
- Buttons are short verb phrases in Title Case: “Donate Now”, “Donate Now”, “Learn More”.
- Navigation uses single nouns: “Dashboard”, “Programs”, “Impact”, “Partners”.
- The reference page uses emoji as inline glyphs (🌱 🏫 📍 💧 🌾 ©); keep them functional, never decorative.

## Color

- Set the page on `page-bg` with body text in `page-text`. The theme is light.
- Identity colours: `impact-cream`, `impact-green`, `sage-green`, `earth-brown`. Lead with the first; use the rest for accents and emphasis.
- Status colours (`success`, `warning`, `info`) always travel with a word or icon; never signal state by hue alone.
- Each token's note says where the reference page uses it and, for text colours, its contrast on `page-bg`. Keep body text at 4.5:1 or better.

### Palette rationale

- --impact-cream: #fefce8      → Warm foundation, welcoming openness
- --impact-green: #059669      → Active change, growth, environmental health
- --earth-brown: #92400e       → Grounded mission, stable foundation
- --leaf-green: #10b981        → Fresh initiatives, new programs
- --soil-dark: #44403c         → Deep roots, lasting change
- --sky-blue: #0ea5e9          → Clean water, clear skies, hope
- --sun-amber: #f59e0b         → Energy, optimism, warmth
- --stone-gray: #78716c        → Stability, trust, permanence

## Typography

- `display` — -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

Faces are hosted on Google Fonts (Roboto); load them with:

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Roboto&display=swap">
```

The reference page names Roboto without loading it, so it shows a fallback face; the last link above loads the intended face.

- Set titles in `display`, sections in `heading-2` and running text in `body`.
- Uppercase is reserved for small labels (`label`), always with the letter-spacing given.

### Type rationale

- System fonts: Accessible, readable, universal
- Humanist sans-serif: Friendly, approachable, professional
- Clear hierarchy: Mission-critical information prioritized
- Generous spacing: Room to breathe, reduce cognitive load
- Impact numbers: Large, bold, celebratory statistics

## Spacing, shape and elevation

- Spacing steps: `space-xs` 6px, `space-sm` 12px, `space-md` 20px, `space-lg` 32px, `space-xl` 48px, `space-2xl` 72px. Pad cards and sections from these steps only.
- Corners: `radius-sm` 6px, `radius-md` 12px, `radius-lg` 20px, `radius-xl` 28px, `radius-full` 9999px.
- Elevation: `shadow-sm`, `shadow-md`, `shadow-lg`, `shadow-xl`, lowest first for resting cards, higher for hover and overlays.

1. Impact Cards: Mission metrics with growth indicators
2. Beneficiary Stories: Human-centered narrative cards
3. Program Progress: Organic progress bars with milestones
4. Donation Tracking: Transparent financial accountability
5. Partner Grid: Collaborative ecosystem visualization
6. Campaign Stats: Real-time social impact dashboards
7. Volunteer Hours: Community contribution tracking
8. Sustainability Score: Environmental impact measurement

## States and motion

Timing values: `--transition-fast` 150ms ease-out, `--transition-base` 250ms ease-out, `--transition-slow` 400ms ease-out.

- Honour `prefers-reduced-motion`: drop lifts and transitions to instant state changes.

## Iconography

- Inline SVG line icons on a 24×24 viewBox, 2px stroke, drawn in `currentColor` so they take the text colour around them.
- No logo ships with this style: set the organization name in the `display` style.

## Accessibility

- `page-text` on `page-bg` measures 7.4:1.
- Every interactive element shows a visible focus state at 3:1 or better against its surface.
- Measured on `page-bg`, these text colours fall short of 4.5:1: `impact-green` 3.6:1, `leaf-green` 2.5:1, `sky-blue` 2.7:1, `sun-amber` 2.1:1, `gray-300` 1.4:1, `gray-400` 2.4:1, `category-tag-bg` 1.0:1. Use them only for large text (24px+) or on the fills their notes name, whatever the design notes below claim.

From the style's design notes (ratios checked against the tokens; a **bold** measurement replaces a claim that does not hold):

- WCAG 2.1 Level AAA target for all text
- Minimum 7:1 contrast for body text (cream on brown)
- Color + icon + text redundancy for all status indicators
- Semantic HTML for screen readers
- Keyboard navigation throughout
- Focus indicators on all interactive elements

## Component inventory

The reference page composes these patterns from the tokens above:

1. Impact Cards: Mission metrics with growth indicators
2. Beneficiary Stories: Human-centered narrative cards
3. Program Progress: Organic progress bars with milestones
4. Donation Tracking: Transparent financial accountability
5. Partner Grid: Collaborative ecosystem visualization
6. Campaign Stats: Real-time social impact dashboards
7. Volunteer Hours: Community contribution tracking
8. Sustainability Score: Environmental impact measurement

## Further guidance

### Primary (35%) - Nonprofit Alliance Principles

- Mission-first design: Every element serves social impact goals
- Transparent impact metrics: Clear visualization of outcomes
- Community-centered: Human stories and beneficiary focus
- Trust signals: Accountability, financial transparency
- Accessibility-first: Inclusive design for all stakeholders
- Hope and optimism: Forward-looking, solution-oriented
- Collaborative ethos: Partnership and collective action themes

### Secondary (25%) - Solarpunk Biophilic Aesthetics

- Nature integration: Organic forms, growth metaphors
- Sustainable optimism: Bright, hopeful environmental tones
- Green living systems: Plant-inspired color palettes
- Renewable energy: Clean, efficient design patterns
- Biomimicry: Natural patterns in UI elements
- Community gardens: Cultivation and nurturing themes
- Climate hope: Positive ecological future visualization

### Tertiary (20%) - Organic Modern Minimalism

- Natural materials: Wood tones, earth colors, stone textures
- Tactile warmth: Soft, approachable surfaces
- Fluid forms: Gentle curves, flowing layouts
- Handcrafted feel: Artisanal, human-touched aesthetic
- Warm neutrals: Cream, sand, terracotta foundations
- Mindful simplicity: Purposeful, uncluttered spaces
- Sustainable materials: Eco-conscious visual language

### Quaternary (20%) - Duotone Impact

- High-contrast storytelling: Bold visual narratives
- Photographic depth: Image-driven communication
- Color psychology: Strategic emotional pairing
- Brand consistency: Limited palette for recognition
- Accessibility: Strong contrast ratios for readability
- Artistic expression: Creative visual treatments
- Dramatic emphasis: Hero moments with duotone overlays

### Temperature

- (Warm and hopeful)

### Formality

- (Professional yet approachable)

### Compatibility Matrix

- Nonprofit Alliance × Solarpunk Biophilic: 95% SYNERGY
- Shared values: Social good, sustainability, community
- Mutual reinforcement: Mission-driven meets eco-optimism
- Visual harmony: Natural growth metaphors align with impact metrics
- Tension point: Corporate professionalism vs. grassroots aesthetic
- Resolution: Warm professionalism with organic accents

- Nonprofit Alliance × Organic Modern: 88% SYNERGY
- Shared values: Humanity, accessibility, warmth
- Mutual reinforcement: Trust through natural, honest materials
- Visual harmony: Earth tones support mission authenticity
- Tension point: Data visualization vs. minimalism
- Resolution: Clean charts with warm, natural color palettes

- Solarpunk Biophilic × Organic Modern: 92% SYNERGY
- Shared values: Sustainability, nature, mindfulness
- Mutual reinforcement: Green optimism meets tactile warmth
- Visual harmony: Perfect blend of eco-consciousness
- Tension point: Futurism vs. handcrafted aesthetic
- Resolution: Modern eco-tech with artisanal warmth

- Duotone × All Blends: 78% SYNERGY
- Enhancement: Adds dramatic visual impact to mission stories
- Challenge: High-contrast can feel stark against organic warmth
- Resolution: Duotone used selectively for hero content, photography
- Integration: Warm duotone pairs (green/cream, earth/white)

## Not synced

Built from `style-125-impact-collective.html`. No component bundle: the reference page's markup is not packaged as live components.
